_comment: Per-circuit evidence for measure_runoff.py that the LIDAR and OSM can't give: what a barrier the LIDAR finds is
(it sees a narrow raised object, not its material), the circuit's default barrier look, and corner-specific facts
from published sources. Barrier types: armco (steel guardrail), tyres (tyre wall faced with plain black conveyor
belting), concrete (wall), bank (earth bank, no barrier), none. 'fence': a debris/catch fence above the barrier.
'colour' is black unless a source confirms red/white (Chris, 2026-10-24: red/white only where the evidence
supports it). Overrides: 'corner' is a label of the sample's corners, 'side' outside|inside|left|right of the
corner (outside = away from the turn's centre at its apex), 'fromM'/'toM' metres along the route relative to
the corner label's sM (default -60..+80); any of surface, startM, depthM, barrier, fence, offsetM set the
zone's value; every override needs a source.
